[EN] The body of Davarn, liberator of the amani, is buried in Davarn's Refuge. But his spirit lives on in the heart of every amani who breathes free.
[ES] El cuerpo de Davarn, liberador de los amani, está enterrado en Davarn's Refuge. Pero su espíritu vive en el corazón de cada amani que respira libremente.
